headline: One Game Into the Dolan Era, the Counter Council Has Already Voted
verdict: One down, one new neighbor recruited, and Ken's respect currently measured at three points and one returned lager.

headline: Kansas State Brings Ken's Favorite Thing to Town: Evidence
verdict: The offense is real, the defense is a rumor, and a fourth-grader named Danny is the most emotionally mature person in this column.

headline: A 45-42 Tuesday Night, and Leo Reyes Is Ruined for Life
verdict: Forty-five scored, forty-two allowed, and one six-year-old from Arizona now permanently, irreversibly a Viking.

headline: Aloha Means Hello, Goodbye, and Three and One
verdict: A tidy win, a worried neighbor, and a trivia team that knows more about Honolulu than it wanted to.

headline: Ken Said 'Let's See It in Lubbock.' Lubbock Has Been Seen.
verdict: A gutsy road loss, a defense with a pulse, a kielbasa prophecy fulfilled, and one father in Florida with the best take of the week.

headline: Dallas, Dealt With: Vikings Bounce Back at SMU
verdict: Two wins in one day for Coach Mickey, a deli pickle as a warning shot, and one nice sentence from Ken that he'll deny under oath.

headline: Three Points Short in Boulder, and Sal Had the Clippers Ready
verdict: Close again, short again, and the only thing that got shut down more efficiently than the offense was Mickey's hairline.

headline: A Pierogi, a Viking and a Kansas Blowout Walk Into Halloween
verdict: A complete, comfortable win, a four-year-old dumpling with a full-size candy bar, and Ken watching the Ohio forecast through his fingers.

headline: Sorry, Dad: The Bobcats Came, Saw and Kept Scoring
verdict: Ohio taught the class, the Vikings took notes, and Mickey's daughter is now, officially, the enemy he'd give his life for.

headline: Cowboys Corralled: A Three-Point Answer to a 25-Point Question
verdict: A gutsy answer after the Ohio lesson, a bowl ticket punched, Chester on his feet, and Ken's first happy album in eight years.

headline: Orlando Was Warm, Sarasota Was Warmer
verdict: Seven wins, a pipefitter from Akron, and the best replay of the season, watched three times in a living room in Sarasota.

headline: 46-45. That's It. That's the Headline.
verdict: One point, five pierogi, one converted wife, one bet to collect from Nadia, and a doubter who will deny yelling until the end of time.

headline: Liberty Bowl Champions: Mickey's Closet Needs a Bigger Door
verdict: Nine wins, a bowl trophy, a Mackey Award, a crayon Viking on the fridge, and a doubter who said "Merry Christmas" in print, which is basically a confession.

headline: The Bazelak Is on the Board, and the Freshman Is in Charge
verdict: A freshman in charge, a sandwich on the board, and Ken's first secret compliment of the year delivered to a kielbasa.

headline: The Air Force Can't Fly Over This Defense, and Leo Reyes Has a Flag
verdict: Two wins, one flag pulled, and a jazz record that perfectly captures Ken's refusal to enjoy anything.

headline: Vikings Defeat an Entire Region, 56-13
verdict: Fifty-six points against a region, a sausage prophecy fulfilled, and the best laugh Ray Hogmanes has had all year.

headline: Louisville Is a City, and the Vikings Just Annexed It
verdict: Sixty-two points, a city annexed, a slicer silenced, and Nadia accidentally saying something nice.

headline: Houston, We Have a Five-and-Oh
verdict: Five and oh, a barber's grudge, and one piece of advice for a freshman quarterback from a father in Sarasota.

headline: Six and Oh in the Cornfields, and the Lunch Table Is Losing Its Mind
verdict: Six and oh in the cornfields, Chester has spoken, and Big Stan has a napkin under the register that Ken is legally prevented from describing.

headline: Boulder Again. Of Course It Was Boulder.
verdict: The undefeated dream ends in Boulder again, Donna makes tea, and Ken admits, very briefly, that he'd started to believe.

headline: Two Points, One Bobblehead, and a Bet Ken Will Never Let Go
verdict: A rivalry win by two, a green felt cape that refuses to come off, and one bobblehead turned toward the wall in Ohio City.

headline: Arizona Wins the Day, and the Counter Council Goes Quiet
verdict: A hard loss on a hard week, a quiet deli, and one white lie in Sarasota that was the kindest thing anyone did all Saturday.

headline: 56-38 in Athens: Mickey Texts His Daughter Back
verdict: Fifty-six in Athens, the storm passed, a "sorry, kiddo" a year in the making, and breakfast with the enemy, who is also family.

headline: Nine Wins, a Turned Pennant and an Eleven-Week Losing Streak at Trivia
verdict: Nine wins, a pennant facing the wall, a plaque for consistency, and a skull icon in a spreadsheet pointing straight at Manhattan, Kansas.

headline: Leftovers in Manhattan, Kansas: K-State Hands Us the Bill
verdict: A rough night in Kansas, a much better Thursday in Old Brooklyn, and a father in Florida who remembered the pierogi.

headline: Texas Bowl Champions, Ten Wins and a Number Next to Our Name
verdict: Ten wins, a Texas Bowl trophy, a number next to our name, a neighbor who now says "we," and a father in Florida who remembered.

headline: Year Three Opens With a Rout and a Freshman Named Cleveland
verdict: A rout to open year three, a five-star freshman with the whole city on his back, and Ken's band reunion indefinitely postponed.

headline: Tulsa? TULSA? Ken Has Never Been Happier to Be Miserable
verdict: A loss nobody saw coming, a spreadsheet in shock, a child's case against stairs, and the right advice from a man who thought it was about fishing.

headline: A Shootout Win, an Engagement Ring and a Carpenter Who Asked First
verdict: A bounce-back win, a carpenter with manners, and a free ring of kielbasa that may be legally binding in Slavic Village.

headline: The Boulder Curse Is Broken, and Ken Put On a Happy Record
verdict: Boulder conquered at last, Sal's Bermuda Triangle closed, and Ken's neighbor upgraded to full sentences.

headline: Big Stan Names a Sandwich After a Freshman, and Middle Tennessee Gets the Leftovers
verdict: Four and one, a two-plate sandwich, a box carried out like a casket, and a five-game road trip looming like November weather.

headline: Lubbock, Revisited: The Road Trip Starts With a Payback
verdict: Lubbock repaid with interest, a spiral out of the hedge, and a Doom Model that has started answering in single words.

headline: 59-53 in Oxford: The Bobblehead Remembers, and So Does Ken
verdict: Fifty-nine points in Oxford, a bobblehead now staring at Ken, and four retellings of a basketball joke for the best audience in Sarasota.

headline: Halloween in Orlando, and Somebody Else Handed Out My Candy
verdict: A third straight road win on Halloween, a six-year-old Big Stan running the candy line, and one dignified "caw" in Ohio City.

headline: Four for Four on the Road, and Salt Lake City Is Very Clean
verdict: Four road wins in a row, a very clean city introduced to the cardigan, and a big band record sitting on Ken's shelf like a dare.

headline: One Point in Tucson, and Ken Finally Played the Record
verdict: Five for five on the road, one point in Tucson, a deli owner bench-pressing a columnist, and a big band record finally allowed to play.

headline: Ten Wins Before Thanksgiving, and the Whole Street Is Nervous About Saturday
verdict: Ten wins before Thanksgiving, a pennant that crept back around while nobody was looking, and a doubter who honestly doesn't know.

headline: One Point. Ohio. Two Days After Thanksgiving.
verdict: One point, a great game on the wrong side, a careful Thanksgiving prayer, and the one thing Ray Hogmanes will never forget about Ohio.

headline: Alamo Bowl Champions, Eleven Wins and a Camp Award With Our Name on It
verdict: Eleven wins, an Alamo Bowl trophy, a Walter Camp winner who didn't get cocky, and a door that's officially propped open.

headline: The Hocker Goes Up on the Board, and a Kenny Arrives Who Can Catch
verdict: The Hocker on the board, a junior quarterback in command, and a freshman Kenny who, for now, has all the belief in the family.

headline: Five Points Over Kent State, and Ken Reached for the Same Record as Somebody
verdict: A close win over the neighbors, a nine-year-old cornerback who always thinks he's got him, and one quiet piano trio that two people reached for at once.

headline: Desert Heat, a Four-Point Escape and a Wedding Countdown
verdict: A four-point escape in the desert, homemade tamales, a toast with only four football references, and a 7 a.m. coffee that was "practical."

headline: Sixty-Three Points and the Whole Turnpike Can Hear Us
verdict: Sixty-three points, a sausage prophet vindicated, a stadium chanting Ken's name by accident, and a book that stayed closed.

headline: Baylor Gets Bowled Over, and Mickey Writes His Toast on a Napkin
verdict: Five and oh, a toast that's mostly about sandwiches, and one doubter whose father finally approves of something without needing to see the scoreboard.

headline: A Wedding, a Kazoo and a 29-Point Win in Lubbock
verdict: A daughter married, a kazoo fight song for the ages, a twenty-nine-point win in Lubbock, and a place card nobody will admit to writing.

headline: 53-49: Nadia's Trophy Says 'We'll See.' We Saw.
verdict: A hundred and two points, seven and oh, a sign on the storm door, and a pronoun Ken will be thinking about until Christmas.

headline: Halloween in Orlando, the Scary Kind
verdict: A Halloween horror show in Orlando, a little Viking who adjusted her talking points, and a doubter who chose soup over suffering and doesn't regret it.

headline: 35-7 in Athens: The Pennant Goes to the Wall Again
verdict: Ohio held to seven in Athens, a pennant back to the wall, and photographic evidence that Ken Hogmanes can smile, framed next to an eclipse.

headline: Tucson Again, Easier This Time
verdict: Tucson made easy, Leo's first official tackle (a hug, ruled committed), and one doubter's pile of reasons getting very, very small.

headline: Three Points Short in Stillwater, and the P-Word Goes Back in the Car
verdict: Three points short in Stillwater, a note on a door, and a father who picked up the phone on his own to ask the only question that matters.

headline: Thanksgiving, Two New Chairs and a Five-Point Win Over Utah
verdict: Ten and two, two handmade oak chairs, one perfect pumpkin pie, and a doubter who has, by his own admission, been absorbed into the family.

headline: Pop-Tart Bowl Champions, the Best Offense in America and a Kenny Who Catches Everything
verdict: Eleven wins, a third straight bowl trophy, the best offense in America, a second Mackey tight end, and Ray Hogmanes ordering his son outside.

headline: Big Stan Hangs a Blank Board, and the Senior Starts in Lexington
verdict: A road win in Lexington to open the senior season, Donna labeling jerseys for an estate sale, and a blank board at Big Stan's that nobody will name out loud.

headline: Kent State, Ken's Alma Mater, Gets the Bad News in Person
verdict: A thirty-seven-point road win down Route 43, one apology to Phil, and Leo Reyes officially, finally, got him.

headline: Toledo Hangs Around, and Ray Asks If the Kid Is Still the Kid
verdict: A medium morning, a fourteen-point win, and a father in Sarasota reminding his son that seniors don't come back.

headline: Sixty-Three in Provo, and the Trivia Team Wins a Round
verdict: Forty-two points of daylight in Provo, Gerald sitting on command, and a sticky note that reads "Except Sports" on the most consistent plaque in Ohio City.

headline: Stillwater, Settled: Thirty-Two Points of Payback
verdict: Stillwater repaid with thirty-two, a pennant staring Mickey down, and a soup pot emoji that may be the most emotionally sophisticated text Ken has ever received.

headline: Utah Comes to Town, and Sofia Reyes Learns the Fight Song in Two Languages
verdict: Six and oh, a bilingual fight song with a soup verse, and Ken Hogmanes leaning back on a couch for the first time in fourteen years.

headline: Seven and Oh, and Everybody's Looking at Next Week
verdict: Seven and oh, a seating chart in a breast pocket, a board dusted daily, and preventive soup on the stove in Tremont.

headline: Ohio Again. By Three. In Our House. Again.
verdict: Three points to Ohio, a cryptic text from Athens, a half-price haircut from a barber who sees December coming, and soup that turned from preventive to acute.

headline: Orlando Owed Us Twenty-Eight Points, and Paid in Full
verdict: Orlando repaid with interest, a ten-year-old coach who understands rivalries without knowing they exist, and one word, "adjacent," that Ken will never get over.

headline: Arizona State Gets the Full Cleveland Welcome
verdict: A thirty-three-point welcome to Cleveland, a Phoenix native in a hand-knit scarf, and Ray Hogmanes saying the word the whole city's whispering.

headline: 84-70. Eighty-Four to Seventy. In Oxford. Donna Is Three and Oh.
verdict: A hundred and fifty-four points in Oxford, Donna's cape made official, and a tiny green ribbon on a bar trophy that means more than it should.

headline: Seventy Points, Eleven Wins, and Ohio Waiting in the Title Game
verdict: Eleven wins, a carved oak chair, a tray of pierogi labeled for the rematch, and everyone in two cities knowing exactly what comes next.

headline: BIG 12 CHAMPIONS. Over Ohio. By Thirty-One.
verdict: The first Big 12 title of the Dolan era, won by thirty-one over the team that owned our address, a pennant retired, and a father who told his son to write it down.

headline: The First Playoff Game in Program History, and It Was Ohio State
verdict: The first playoff win in program history, over Ohio State, a stranger calling Mickey "Pop," and a nurse holding a doubter's hand through the longest quarter of his life.

headline: Midnight Strikes for Cinderella: The Vikings Are Playing for It All
verdict: Cinderella's clock struck, Chester laid his hand on the reserved board, the Doom Model said "OK," and a father practiced his son's phone number all afternoon to ask about Georgia.

headline: NATIONAL CHAMPIONS
verdict: National champions: a sandwich for the whole city, a Heisman winner who started as a three-star freshman, and Ray Hogmanes saying "we" with a clear voice from Sarasota.

headline: Life After Hocker Begins With Seventy-One Points
verdict: Seventy-one points to start life after Hocker, a retired sandwich for a dollar more, and one doubter moving eleven hundred records into a home with a real plant.

headline: A Fourteen-Point Road Win and Four Hundred Boxes of Jazz
verdict: Two and oh, four hundred and twelve boxes carried up three flights, and a polka record smuggled into a jazz collection by a believer with a truck.

headline: The New Coordinator Beats His Old Team, and Leo Reyes Is Eleven
verdict: A coordinator's homecoming in reverse, an eleven-year-old captain passing down the recipe, and a bobblehead staring at Ken with a calm that should worry everyone.

headline: Waco Is Warm, Sal Is Planning Something, and Ray Wants to Know About the Plant
verdict: Forty-one points in Waco, a pennant waiting in a tube from Athens, and a plant in Ohio City that Ken has been told, by the highest authority he knows, to keep alive.

headline: Seventy-Six in Provo, and Big Stan Paints The Baraka
verdict: Seventy-six points in Provo, a fifth board at Big Stan's with a double-pierogi sandwich, and a deli owner quietly infiltrating Tuesday trivia.

headline: Six and Oh, and the Record Negotiation Reaches a Ceasefire
verdict: Six and oh, a nine-year-old with a clipboard and a future, a records treaty signed in a hallway, and a text from Nadia that reads like a weather warning.

headline: The Bet Flips: Ken Pours, Ken Says It
verdict: The RedHawks end a five-year streak in our building, Ken pays the bet with dignity and a hand-pulled beer, and a green ribbon goes back into a wallet to wait.

headline: UCF Pays for Last Week, and Ray Remembers the Kid's Name
verdict: A thirty-five-point bounce-back, an eleven-year-old's first interception, and a father in Sarasota filing a new quarterback's name and finding it again.

headline: 49-21 in Athens, and the Tube Stays Rolled Up
verdict: Three straight wins in Athens, a pennant still sealed in its tube, and the word "January" sent from a press box like a reservation.

headline: Utah Held to Six, and Teddy Is Speechless
verdict: Utah held to two field goals, a speechless sausage oracle, and Ken talked into ballroom dancing during the one moment he couldn't say no.

headline: Lubbock Remembers, and the Trend Line Takes a Detour
verdict: Lubbock's trend line takes a detour, Big Stan's grief protocol is activated, and Ken learns that a box step is the hardest shape in the world.

headline: Ten Wins, a Thanksgiving in a New Apartment, and the RedHawks Again
verdict: Ten and two, a hug and a Baraka for an old coordinator, the first Thanksgiving in Ken's home, and a Bobcat in Athens too busy for pie.

headline: The RedHawks Win the Big 12, and Nadia Gives the Ribbon Back
verdict: The RedHawks take the Big 12 title, the gap closes to six, and a green ribbon goes back across a bar table on loan, waiting for a rubber match.

headline: Oklahoma Falls in the First Round, and the Rubber Match Is On
verdict: Oklahoma handled by thirty, a pennant tube uncapped, an eleven-year-old doing real push-ups, and a father's coaching for the rubber match: win the fight.

headline: The Rubber Match Goes to Cleveland, and the Ribbon Goes Home
verdict: The trilogy goes to Cleveland by six, Donna's cape stays undefeated away from home, and a green ribbon changes hands for the last time this season.

headline: Georgia Again, and Now the Whole Family Plays for It
verdict: Georgia beaten for the second straight January, a father and daughter on opposite sides of a national title game, and a barber buying club sodas like he's read the last page.

headline: Ohio Wins It All, and Mickey Hugs the Enemy
verdict: Ohio's first national title in a run nobody saw coming, a father hugging his daughter outside the winners' press room, and a granola bar slid across a press-box table without a word.
